note: Facets Block provides one Block plugin, id 'facets_block' (class FacetsBlock), depending on the Facets module. No settings form, no configure route, no permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. Configuration lives in the block config entity block.block.<id> under settings: show_title (def TRUE), exclude_empty_facets (def TRUE), hide_empty_block (def FALSE), add_js_classes (def FALSE), facets_to_include (array of 'facet_block:<facet_id>' / 'facets_summary_block:<facet_id>'). hook_facets_block_facets_alter() alters the facets array; theme hook 'facets_block'; per-facet class facet-block--<id>. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real block config: introspection reads a placed Facets Block's settings; execution places/configures a facets_block block, verified against the live block.block config. Note: no real facet source is required for the block config to be valid.

evals.prompt: How do I use the facets_block module to show several Search API facets together in one block, and what is the block plugin called?
evals.expected_output: Place the 'Facets Block' block (plugin id facets_block) from Structure > Block layout into a region, and in its block form tick the facets to include under 'Facets to include'. It renders all selected facets (and Facets Summary blocks) in that single block. Requires the Facets module and configured facets.

evals.prompt: What settings does the facets_block block expose, and what does 'Hide empty block' do versus 'Exclude empty facets'?
evals.expected_output: Settings: show_title, exclude_empty_facets, hide_empty_block, add_js_classes, and facets_to_include. exclude_empty_facets skips individual facets that have no options; hide_empty_block renders nothing at all when the block has no facets to show (e.g. no search results).

evals.prompt: In the facets_block configuration, the list of facets to include is stored as facets_to_include. What is the id format of each entry, and how are Facets Summary blocks referenced?
evals.expected_output: Each entry is a block plugin id: 'facet_block:<facet_id>' for a normal facet, and 'facets_summary_block:<facet_id>' for a Facets Summary. They are stored as an array under settings.facets_to_include.

evals.prompt: This site has a Facets Block placed with machine name fb_known. Inspect its live block configuration and list which facets it is configured to include.
evals.expected_output: The fb_known block (plugin facets_block) has settings.facets_to_include = ['facet_block:brand', 'facet_block:color'], i.e. it includes the brand and color facets.

evals.prompt: This site has two Facets Block instances, fb_a and fb_b. Exactly one of them is configured to not render at all when it has no facets to show. Inspect the live block configuration and state which block hides itself when empty.
evals.expected_output: fb_a has settings.hide_empty_block = true, so it renders nothing when empty; fb_b has hide_empty_block = false.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, place a Facets Block (plugin facets_block) with machine name fb_task in a region of the default theme. Configure it so that facet titles are NOT shown (show_title off) and JS classes ARE added (add_js_classes on), and make sure the block is enabled. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A block.block.fb_task config entity exists with plugin facets_block, status enabled, settings.show_title = false and settings.add_js_classes = true (placed via Block layout or Block::create in the default theme).

evals.prompt: This site already has a Facets Block placed with machine name fb_conf, but 'Add JS classes' and 'Hide empty block' are both currently off. Reconfigure fb_conf so that BOTH 'Add JS classes' (add_js_classes) and 'Hide empty block' (hide_empty_block) are turned on, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In block.block.fb_conf (plugin facets_block) settings.add_js_classes is true and settings.hide_empty_block is true.
